about: C2a Home, folders, What's New (HA §10.2, §10.4; PLAN §1.7 default profile). Every rule is behind wp.c2a (inert until V2 accepts the package). Plates and mosaic bands are DOM attributes set by 41-home.js (data-lgs-plate, data-lgs-plate-id, data-lgs-plate-tint, data-lgs-plate-inset, data-lgs-mosaic), not rules. Only the attended item pops, +15 mm, non-interactive; the card's Play and More hits are 80 px, so rule 2 admits +15. No pop while a section or page change animates (exclude .lgs-home-moving). The legacy 'tabs', 'tab-arrow' and 'card' rules still match Steam's Home: they are superseded at M4: the fragment flag now gates supersedes too (P6, reporter.md §3.1), but 'card' and 'tabs' also serve the library routes, so the ids are chosen with C2c's 40-library.json. M4 written, not yet run in a native session (round R1). Session 5: the card and name plate come before the disc (a later layer that overlaps a kept one is dropped), and the disc of the card's own cell does not pop (it is under the card); neighbours the card covers set data-lgs-plate-occluder=false.
